یہ بیان ایسے وقت میں سامنے آیا ہے جب خطے اور دنیا بھر میں امن و امان کی صورتحال کو بہتر بنانے کے لیے مختلف سطح پر سفارتی رابطے جاری ہیں۔ پاکستان نے ہمیشہ خطے کے تنازعات کو بات چیت اور ثالثی کے ذریعے حل کرنے پر زور دیا ہے تاکہ بین الاقوامی سطح پر استحکام قائم رہ سکے۔

stories.title: UN Projects Zero Growth for Global Maritime Trade in 2026
stories.summary:
Global maritime trade, which accounts for moving over 80 percent of the world's goods, is projected to experience zero growth in the year 2026. According to the United Nations trade and development agency UNCTAD, this stagnation follows a modest expansion of 1.9 percent in 2025 and is driven by persistent shipping disruptions and trade uncertainties stemming from conflict in the Middle East.

The disruptions heavily impact key corridors such as the Strait of Hormuz—a vital route for roughly a fifth of global oil and items like fertilizer—as well as the Red Sea, Black Sea, and Panama Canal. UNCTAD reported that gross tonnage traffic through the Strait of Hormuz plummeted by approximately 95 percent by early March, dropping from around 120 daily crossings before the crisis. Consequently, many vessels are rerouting around the Cape of Good Hope, leading to longer voyages, inflated operating costs, and heightened freight volatility.

While alternative transport networks have kept trade moving at higher costs, the ongoing bottlenecks disproportionately pressure developing economies. Interim UNCTAD chief Pedro Manuel Moreno warned that a prolonged fuel shock could push consumer prices in least-developed countries to almost twice the global average increase.

To combat these vulnerabilities, UNCTAD urges governments and industry stakeholders to move beyond a reactive crisis response. The agency emphasizes that long-term resilience requires better preparation, predictable rules, robust international cooperation, and investments in global fleets, ports, and seafarer protection.

stories.title: Minister Tarar Critiques Fazl and Bilawal Over Protests and Constitutional Debates
stories.summary:
Information Minister Attaullah Tarar censured Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam-Fazl (JUI-F) chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman for organising protests that disrupted traffic across multiple cities. Speaking on the Geo News programme 'Aaj Shazeb Khanzada Kay Saath', Tarar minimised the disruptions and advised the JUI-F leader to step back from confrontation and seek alternative paths instead of blocking thoroughfares. He asserted that Fazl was pursuing a confrontational path despite receiving contrary advice from members within his own party.

Tarar drew sharp comparisons, stating the JUI-F's conduct resembled that of a militant organisation and demanding that Fazl clarify whether his loyalties lay with Pakistan or with Afghanistan and the Taliban. Although JUI-F protests caused urban traffic blockades, most affected routes subsequently reopened. The information minister also targeted Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari for opposing a public referendum on the creation of new provinces, arguing that the public should be permitted to voice opinions on the matter rather than having the PPP chairman show reluctance.

Furthermore, Tarar questioned Bilawal's characterisation of PTI founder Imran Khan as a political prisoner, contending that Bilawal incorrectly applied political arguments in legal matters. Despite disagreements on specific political questions, the minister clarified that ties between the ruling coalition parties remained intact and suggested the PTI could be consulted if new provinces reached parliament. Bilawal had previously rejected a referendum during a Multan address on November 26, calling it potentially the most controversial in national history and insisting parliament address the issue democratically.

The proposal for creating new provinces has sparked internal disagreements within the ruling coalition, with the PPP urging that matters be settled through constitutional avenues in parliament. Reports from The News on November 22 indicated that no formal governmental proposal for a provincial referendum had been initiated within relevant ministries, the Prime Minister's Office, or the Election Commission of Pakistan.

stories.title: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif Directs Urgent Reforms in Gemstone Sector
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has called for immediate actions to modernize Pakistan's gemstone industry during a high-level review meeting in Islamabad. He emphasized that outdated mining practices and an absence of sufficient processing facilities currently result in severe economic losses. To counter this, the government aims to transform the sector from raw material extraction to finished product exports.

Key figures presented during the session revealed that Pakistan holds roughly 300 million carats of gemstone reserves, with over 9,000 miners extracting more than 30 varieties of precious stones. The industry involves more than 5,500 businesses nationwide. However, more than half of the material is lost during mining operations, and the sector continues to suffer from a lack of technical expertise and limited value-addition capabilities.

To address these gaps, Prime Minister Sharif ordered the creation of international-standard laboratories for gemstone certification and identification. He also mandated that master trainers be sent to Thailand and Sri Lanka for specialized processing instruction, with support from the foreign secretary and local diplomatic missions. Additionally, a Rs4.10 billion initiative is underway to build facilitation centres across Islamabad, Azad Jammu and Kashmir, and Gilgit-Baltistan.

These comprehensive measures matter because they seek to elevate the credibility and competitiveness of Pakistani gemstones on the global stage. By improving technical skills and local certification processes, the administration intends to capture greater long-term value from the country's extensive natural mineral resources and boost national export volumes.

stories.title: FBR Sets New Quota Rules for Duty-Free Solvent and White Spirit Imports
stories.summary:
The Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) has established a formal quota allocation framework for eligible manufacturers importing and locally procuring white spirit and solvent oil without federal excise duty. Issued via SRO 2286 of 2026, the directive amends the Federal Excise Rules 2005 by adding a dedicated chapter to oversee quota distribution, input tax adjustments, and consumption monitoring.

Under the updated regulations, registered manufacturers with a valid Form-L licence must submit annual quantity requests to the Inland Revenue Commissioner. Applicants are required to disclose their production capacity, historical consumption figures from the past two financial years, supplier names, and input-to-output ratios. The commissioner evaluates these details using sales tax returns, electronic invoices, import declarations, and physical inspections when necessary, with a decision window of one month.

Established manufacturers receive quotas based on the previous year's finished product supplies or a two-year average with a 10 percent allowance, whereas newer units operating under a year are capped at 50 percent of their installed capacity. The rules stipulate that allocated materials must be consumed within six months, and companies must submit quarterly reports alongside annual reconciliations. The commissioner holds the authority to suspend quotas for up to one month if diversion, fraud, or missing reports are suspected.

This regulatory update matters because it introduces stringent oversight to prevent the misuse or fraudulent declaration of duty-free industrial inputs. Furthermore, taxable goods producers must integrate with the FBR's electronic invoicing system to qualify for duty-free supplies, with any violations triggering duty recovery, surcharges, and legal penalties.

stories.title: Pakistan Stock Exchange Closes Lower Amid Regional Tensions and Cautious Trading
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Stock Exchange experienced a sluggish trading session on Thursday, giving up early morning gains to close slightly lower as investors adopted a cautious stance. Market participants weighed persistent regional geopolitical tensions, a lack of positive economic catalysts, and profit-taking during rollover week. Topline Securities reported that market activity remained subdued and range-bound throughout the day.

The benchmark KSE-100 index finished the session down 60.56 points, or 0.03 percent, settling at 178,060.69. During trading, the index fluctuated between a low of 177,781 and a high of 178,374. Positive momentum from selective buying in second- and third-tier stocks was offset by selling pressure in major equities. Key positive contributors such as Engro Holdings, Engro Fertiliser, PSO, Interloop Ltd, and Bank Al-Habib added roughly 290 points, while major draggers including Pakistan Services, Fauji Fertiliser, and United Bank subtracted about 175 points. Ali Najib, Deputy Head of Trading at Arif Habib Ltd, noted that thin global liquidity due to the US Thanksgiving holiday also influenced sentiment.

Trading volume slipped to 617 million shares, while the total traded value remained flat at Rs18.2 billion, with Pervez Ahmed Co leading the volume chart by trading over 80.2 million shares. In broader developments, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Türkiye prepared to convene in Islamabad on November 27-28 for discussions regarding their mutual defense agreement. Additionally, the stock exchange announced plans to introduce monthly options contracts on selected individual stocks by June 2027 in partnership with Chinese stakeholders who hold a 40 percent stake in the PSX.

stories.title: United Nations Launches Global Campaign Against Rising Gender-Based Violence Worldwide
stories.summary:
The United Nations launched its annual 16 Days of Activism campaign against gender-based violence on Wednesday, urging global societies and governments to reject abuse, support survivors, and demand accountability. Running until Human Rights Day on December 10, the initiative emphasizes that systemic disbelief, victim-blaming, and unanswered calls for help foster an environment of impunity for perpetrators. The campaign highlights escalating concerns over physical and digital abuse, particularly in environments where inadequate protections discourage victims from seeking assistance.

To contextualize the crisis, a UN report released on November 25 regarding Pakistan revealed that online harassment frequently spills into physical dangers, contributing to femicide, suicides, physical assaults, and job losses. Survey data from Pakistan indicated that 54 percent of women believe victims should leave their jobs when harassed, while 83 percent noted that male perpetrators often evade consequences. Regionally and globally, the figures remain stark. In Arab states, 60 percent of female internet users reported experiencing online violence. Furthermore, the UN Office on Drugs and Crime and UN Women estimated that 50,000 women and girls were killed globally by intimate partners or family members in 2024, averaging 137 deaths every day, or one every ten minutes.

The campaign launch also brought renewed attention to Afghanistan, where UN Women warned that the safety of women and girls is deteriorating rapidly. Susan Ferguson, UN Women’s Special Representative in Afghanistan, emphasized that while risks are mounting, essential support networks are collapsing due to severe funding and aid cuts. The UN continues to press governments, technology corporations, and local authorities to reinforce legal protections, adequately fund support organizations, and hold offenders strictly accountable.

stories.title: Nine Injured in Massive Oil Facility Explosion in Bangkok
stories.summary:
A powerful blast struck an oil facility in the Phra Khanong area of eastern Bangkok on Thursday, leaving nine people injured, with three in critical condition. According to reporters at the scene, the explosion generated a massive column of flames followed by thick black smoke, and the force of the blast rattled doors several kilometres away.

Thailand’s Energy Minister, Akanat Promphan, visited the site and noted that the fire originated at a distillation tower located at least 100 metres away from the main oil depot, which helped limit the overall destruction. The facility is operated by the Thai energy conglomerate Bangchak Corporation, which announced that the situation was brought under control within 30 minutes of the incident.

Authorities conducted air quality checks within a one-kilometre radius of the refinery, testing for contaminants such as carbon monoxide and sulphur dioxide, and reported normal levels with no irregularities detected. However, the government suspended plant operations until the energy ministry is fully confident that work can resume safely. Meanwhile, police evacuated students from nearby schools and asked local residents to leave the area.

The Erawan Emergency Medical Centre, managed by Bangkok city authorities, confirmed the casualty figures, updating its initial assessment to reflect the nine injuries and three critical cases. Investigations into the exact cause of the explosion are currently underway by the company and relevant authorities.

stories.title: Tanker Capsizes off Ibiza Waters, Sparking Environmental Response
stories.summary:
Spanish authorities launched an emergency response on Thursday to prevent marine pollution after a chemical products tanker capsized north of Ibiza. The Maltese-flagged vessel, named Med Emre, was transporting up to 7,000 tonnes of diesel, or approximately 66,000 barrels of refined products, while traveling from Algeciras to Barcelona.

Balearic Islands emergency services reported that all 17 crew members were rescued from the incident. One crew member was later confirmed dead at a hospital in Ibiza, while six others sustained minor injuries, primarily suffering from hypothermia. The cause of the maritime accident remains unclear at this stage.

Government sources clarified that the vessel was lying keel up rather than completely sunk, and images broadcast by Spanish media showed the lower portion of the ship visible above the sea surface. Spain activated a specialized marine pollution response mechanism as a precaution, though officials noted this did not mean pollution had been detected along the coast.

To evaluate potential environmental hazards in the ecologically valuable Mediterranean waters, the Spanish maritime rescue service Salvamento Maritimo dispatched a boat and a plane to the area. Maritime tracking data from Kpler confirmed the cargo details of the capsized vessel as rescue and assessment operations continued.

stories.title: Former IHC Judge Warns Constitutional Amendments Sparked Inter-Court Conflict
stories.summary:
Retired Islamabad High Court Justice Mohsin Akhtar Kayani has cautioned that the 26th and 27th Constitutional Amendments have provoked a direct conflict between Pakistan's superior courts. Speaking at an Institute of Regional Studies seminar in Islamabad titled 'Personal Safety and Justice in a Digital World', he stated that bypassing traditional judicial precedents and establishing problematic new ones has weakened the country's legal structure.

Justice Kayani pointed specifically to legal disputes arising from the Nadia Sarwar case before the Federal Constitutional Court, arguing that parliament remains the correct forum to resolve inter-court disagreements. He stressed that while the interpretation of the Constitution is a judicial duty, crafting legislation is the exclusive domain of lawmakers. He urged parliamentarians to thoroughly debate legal measures before enactment to ensure a complete understanding of their practical implications.

In addition to judicial matters, the former judge criticized the enforcement and understanding of online expression regulations, particularly the Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act (Peca). He highlighted that journalists, lawyers, and members of parliament are frequently impacted by these rules, and noted that the individuals targeted by the legislation were never properly consulted. He specifically appealed to authorities to halt the immediate issuance of notices to media organizations under Section 26-A simply for publishing news reports.

These remarks carry significance as they highlight growing friction between the executive, legislative, and judicial branches following recent constitutional changes. Justice Kayani's warnings underscore ongoing concerns regarding freedom of the press, the protection of media personnel, and the institutional separation of powers in Pakistan's digital age.

stories.title: Quetta Court Grants Bail to Journalist Shahid Maitla
stories.summary:
A district and sessions court in Quetta has approved post-arrest bail for senior journalist Shahid Maitla, ordering his release upon the submission of surety bonds worth Rs3 million. District and Sessions Judge Ghulam Qadir Shah Bukhari delivered the ruling on the bail petition filed on behalf of the journalist.

The legal proceedings against Maitla originated from a formal complaint lodged by former caretaker prime minister Anwaarul Haq Kakar with the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency. Following the complaint, the NCCIA apprehended Maitla in Islamabad, subsequently transferring him to Quetta where he was remanded to jail under judicial orders.

Prior to the sessions court ruling, Maitla's defense team approached Judicial Magistrate Syed Akhtar Shah with a post-arrest bail application, which was initially rejected. Following that setback, Maitla's counsel, Rahib Buleedi, challenged the decision by filing a new petition in the sessions court, which ultimately overturned the earlier ruling and granted his release.

stories.title: US Approves SpaceX Plan to Launch Space Data Center Satellites
stories.summary:
The administration of the United States has granted authorization to Elon Musk’s aerospace firm, SpaceX, to deploy up to one million satellites designed to operate data centers in orbit. According to Federal Communications Commission documents, this approval extends through 2040 for the Starmind constellation, which will process large volumes of data for use on Earth. FCC Chairman Brendan Carr endorsed the move, noting its alignment with artificial intelligence development, while several other entities like Google and Blue Origin are also pursuing similar space-based computing initiatives.

The initiative leverages low Earth orbit constellations and partnerships with chipmakers like Nvidia, which will provide space-ready Vera Rubin processors. Proponents highlight that orbiting data centers can continuously capture solar energy far more efficiently than terrestrial alternatives. SpaceX plans to commence initial satellite launches in late 2027, utilizing its own fleet of rockets to establish the necessary infrastructure.

However, the project has drawn significant criticism from scientific and environmental organizations. The American Astronomical Society expressed deep concern that the brighter, more numerous satellites would severely disrupt astronomical observations and degrade the night sky. Additionally, Earthjustice attorney Jan Hasselman emphasized the broader impacts of such large-scale orbital expansion on the planet.

Technical obstacles also remain a primary concern for observers. Experts point out that hardware must endure extreme temperatures, high space radiation levels, and potential impacts from micrometeorites and space debris. Despite these hurdles, the FCC's clearance marks a major step forward for commercial space infrastructure following SpaceX's recent stock market debut in June, which raised roughly $85.7 billion.

stories.title: Pakistan Launches Its First Ever National Diabetes Prevention and Control Programme
stories.summary:
Pakistan has introduced its inaugural National Diabetes Prevention and Control Programme, launched during a gathering hosted by the Diabetes Association of Pakistan. With estimates suggesting that approximately one in three citizens suffers from diabetes, health advocates view the comprehensive national strategy as an essential step toward mitigating a rapidly growing healthcare crisis.

The initiative, structured alongside the federal health ministry for a three-to-five-year duration, prioritizes public awareness and early risk assessment. A core component of the strategy adopts Bangladesh's mosque-based diabetes screening model, which has previously demonstrated success in reducing new diagnoses locally. Organizers hope that utilizing religious platforms will effectively extend diagnostic screening and health education to millions of citizens.

Special emphasis is directed toward vulnerable groups, particularly pregnant women facing potential gestational diabetes risks. Experts underline that routine blood glucose testing and accessible maternal healthcare are vital to preventing severe complications for both mothers and children, while also lowering future Type 2 diabetes risks.

Ultimately, the long-term success of the programme hinges on robust political backing, proper resource allocation, and cooperation between federal and provincial authorities. Advocates stress that curbing the disease requires collective societal participation, making lifestyle changes, affordable diagnostics, and community-level outreach critical to achieving a healthier population.

stories.title: Pakistan Addresses Social Media Accountability at Recent Policy Seminar
stories.summary:
Pakistan's evolving digital regulatory landscape took center stage at a seminar titled “Social Media Platforms and the Post-truth Era,” hosted by the Sustainable Development Policy Institute. Officials discussed the implementation of the Social Media Protection and Regulatory Authority and recent amendments to the Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act, aimed at holding major technology companies accountable for online content.

Under the updated legal framework, digital platforms, over-the-top services, and major creators must register and designate local representatives in Pakistan. The newly empowered authority holds the mandate to review complaints regarding unlawful material, issue operational directives, and order the removal or blocking of fake information within a 24-hour window to safeguard public safety.

Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi emphasized during the event that freedom of expression cannot serve as protection for crossing four critical boundaries: terrorism, hate speech, incitement to violence, and the exploitation of children. Pointing out that global networks acted on less than half of local counter-terrorism requests, officials argued that mandatory platform registration is necessary to protect vulnerable populations and maintain social stability.

While stakeholders agree on the necessity of curbing online harms and aligning with international standards like the European Union's Digital Services Act, critics have raised concerns. Civil society and legal observers warn that historical precedents of utilizing cybercrime laws to suppress dissent necessitate transparent, independent regulatory oversight to ensure legitimate journalism and critical expression are not silenced.

stories.title: Power Division Proposes FFCA Mechanism to Limit Electricity Tariff Increases
stories.summary:
The Power Division has introduced a forward-looking Fuel Cost Adjustment mechanism designed to cap electricity price increases at approximately Re0.83 per unit, inclusive of taxes, for the final quarter of 2026. This proposed measure seeks to shield consumers and commercial enterprises from extreme volatility in global fuel markets caused by international geopolitical tensions.

According to official statements, the intervention is a direct response to rising international prices for coal and liquefied natural gas following the Iran-United States conflict and subsequent Middle Eastern energy crises. Officials noted that prior policy reforms had successfully lowered national average electricity tariffs from Rs53.04 in March 2024 down to Rs44.28 by March 2026, alongside significant reductions in industrial rates.

However, seasonal winter factors—such as diminished hydropower availability and increased dependence on thermal generation—traditionally elevate production costs. The Power Division stated that proactive load management and optimization strategies have previously protected consumers from much larger FCA spikes, restricting recent combined tariff adjustments to an average of Rs2.38 per unit between April and September 2026.

By implementing the proposed FFCA framework following necessary regulatory approvals from the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority, the government hopes to provide predictable pricing. This predictability is intended to assist businesses in financial planning while safeguarding overall economic activity against unpredictable international energy fluctuations.

stories.title: Industrial Consumers Support Capped Fuel Cost Adjustment Mechanism with Implementation Concerns
stories.summary:
Industrial consumers in Pakistan have welcomed the government's proposed three-month Fuel Cost Adjustment (FCA) mechanism designed to cap electricity tariff increases at Rs0.83 per unit. However, businesses expressed reservations regarding its implementation during a public hearing conducted in Islamabad by the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (NEPRA) concerning the October 2026 FCA. Presided over by NEPRA members Amina Ahmed, Maqsood Anwar Khan, and Ghulamullah Shaikh, the hearing evaluated a request by the Central Power Purchasing Agency-Guaranteed (CPPA-G) for a positive adjustment of Rs2.8819 per unit to recover an additional Rs29.83 billion from distribution companies and K-Electric consumers.

During the proceedings, industry representatives like Lahore industrialist Aamir Sheikh questioned whether the policy would deliver true tariff certainty. The industry requested that the FCA be determined prospectively on the pattern of the Quarterly Tariff Adjustment, allowing businesses to know exact electricity rates at the beginning of each month instead of waiting two months. Participants also criticized various taxation structures and levies on generation fuels, pointing out that petroleum levies on High-Speed Diesel and furnace oil significantly inflate generation costs and render local fuel uncompetitive against imported RLNG.

NEPRA members additionally questioned CPPA-G and the Independent System and Market Operator (ISMO) regarding generation data consistency, plant outages, and operational challenges from consumer solar systems. ISMO representatives noted that battery storage systems are being developed to store surplus daytime solar power for peak hours to reduce overall costs. Industrial consumers further highlighted issues related to cross-subsidies under the Incremental Consumption Package, provisional RLNG billing, and implementation of a Federal Constitutional Court ruling on import cesses.

The discussions matter because electricity tariffs directly dictate industrial competitiveness and operational viability in Pakistan. Ensuring transparency in monthly energy costs, addressing generation constraints, and rationalizing fuel taxation are vital for maintaining industrial output and protecting consumers from unpredictable financial burdens.

stories.title: Pakistan Government Considers Importing an Additional Half-Million Tonnes of Wheat
stories.summary:
The government of Pakistan is evaluating a proposal to import an additional 500,000 tonnes of wheat to secure national requirements, which would bring total planned imports to 1.3 million tonnes for the upcoming period. Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar presided over a meeting of the Steering Committee on Wheat Import in Islamabad on Thursday to review domestic demand and supply projections, stock positions, and import needs for 2026-27.

The deliberations follow ongoing processes to bring in 800,000 tonnes of wheat through the Trading Corporation of Pakistan. During the meeting, the Deputy Prime Minister emphasized the necessity of timely planning, streamlined execution, and close coordination between federal and provincial administrations. These measures aim to guarantee steady grain availability at affordable prices, maintain stable market conditions, and safeguard the interests of both local farmers and consumers.

The high-level meeting brought together key federal and provincial officials, including the Ministers for National Food Security and Research and Commerce, the Minister for Food of Sindh, Special Assistant to the Prime Minister Tariq Bajwa, the Federal Board of Revenue Chairman, and respective ministry secretaries. Their concerted involvement underscores the administrative gravity attached to food security management in the country.

This prospective import plan is crucial for averting domestic shortages, stabilizing food inflation, and managing staple crop supplies effectively. By preemptively addressing supply gaps through strategic federal-provincial cooperation, the administration seeks to insulate local consumers and agricultural stakeholders from severe market volatility.

stories.title: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif Launches Mehfooz Dawa Mobile Application to Target Fake Medicines
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif launched a new mobile application called Mehfooz Dawa, or the Safe Medicine App, in Islamabad on Thursday. Designed to protect public health and restore confidence in the national drug supply, the application allows consumers to scan barcodes on medicine packaging to verify product authenticity, check prices, and review expiry dates. DRAP Chief Executive Officer Dr Obaidullah explained that the app displays a green indicator for genuine medicines and a red indicator for counterfeits, while also enabling users to report unavailable drugs and submit complaints.

Speaking at the launch ceremony, Prime Minister Sharif emphasized that ensuring widespread access to affordable medicine remains a significant challenge for the country. He noted that while wealthy citizens can afford expensive medical care, poverty forces millions of Pakistanis to struggle for basic essential drugs. He also referenced a historical tragedy during his tenure as Punjab chief minister involving fatal cardiac treatments at the Punjab Institute of Cardiology, stressing that the country must learn from past administrative mistakes to establish strict safeguards.

Federal Minister for National Health Services Mustafa Kamal reported that data for more than 92,000 medicines from roughly 700 pharmaceutical companies has already been integrated into a national database. Prime Minister Sharif directed the health, information, and IT ministries, with support from the Special Investment Facilitation Council, to launch a nationwide awareness campaign so that households across Pakistan become familiar with the application. He also urged pharmaceutical manufacturers to cooperate in lowering drug prices.

The initiative matters because counterfeit and substandard pharmaceuticals pose severe hazards to public health and undermine consumer trust in healthcare systems. By providing a digital tool for immediate verification and direct reporting to the Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan, the government aims to eradicate fake drugs from the market.

stories.title: State Bank of Pakistan Introduces Tier 4 Financing Category to Expand Youth Loan Limits
stories.summary:
The State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) has expanded its financing scope under the Prime Minister’s Youth Business and Agriculture Loan Scheme (PMYB & ALS) by raising the maximum loan limit up to Rs25 million through the introduction of a new 'Tier 4' category. Designed to support business expansion and entrepreneurship, the newly created tier provides long-term financing for up to eight years, including a maximum grace period of one year. The bank rate for Tier 4 is set at six-month KIBOR plus 2.4 percent, resulting in an end-user interest rate of 8 percent, backed by a 10 percent first-loss coverage from the government on a portfolio basis.

With this addition, borrowers can secure financing ranging from above Rs7.5 million up to Rs25 million. Previously, loans under the scheme were divided into three tiers: Tier 1 for up to Rs500,000, Tier 2 for amounts above Rs500,000 up to Rs1.5 million, and Tier 3 for amounts above Rs1.5 million up to Rs7.5 million. Additionally, the federal government revised the bank rate for Tier 3 financing to six-month KIBOR plus 2.4 percent, replacing the previous rate of KIBOR plus 3 percent. Previous components concerning laptops and prospective overseas workers have also been reclassified under a new Tier 5 designation.

To foster greater inclusivity, the SBP instructed participating commercial banks to make concerted efforts to elevate the share of women entrepreneurs within the scheme to at least 30 percent. All other conditions, including subsidy mechanisms, remain unchanged, and revised provisions apply exclusively to financing disbursed after the circular's issuance. Eligible applicants include Pakistani citizens holding a Computerized National Identity Card and aged between 21 and 45 years.

This policy update is significant for boosting national enterprise development, scaling up small and medium-sized businesses, and encouraging youth employment. By extending higher capital limits and favorable interest terms, the government and central bank aim to catalyze sustainable economic growth and widen financial inclusion across critical sectors.

stories.title: Pakistan and UNDP Discuss Climate Finance and Investment Projects
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Finance and Revenue Muhammad Aurangzeb held a meeting in Islamabad with a United Nations Development Programme delegation, led by Resident Representative Samuel Rizk, to review Pakistan's development objectives and climate financing opportunities. Both sides agreed to accelerate a shortlist of investment-ready climate projects to attract concessional resources and private investments under Türkiye's COP31 Bridge Initiative.

The discussions highlighted a portfolio featuring initiatives from the SDG Investment Pipeline and Climate Prosperity Plans. These projects encompass clean energy, water and food security, climate resilience, ecosystems, and circular economy strategies. Officials emphasized selecting technically sound projects with concrete implementation pathways to deliver timely results.

Minister Aurangzeb stressed the necessity of a coordinated approach to project design and execution, leveraging existing pipelines and multilateral development partners. The UNDP offered assistance in refining portfolios, performing diagnostic assessments, and connecting with global climate financing mechanisms, particularly for renewable energy and waste management.

The meeting also included UNDP Deputy Resident Representative Van Nguyen, Assistant Resident Representatives Shiraz Ali Shah and Naghma-e-Tehniyat Jerral, and Programme Analyst Bushra Gul. Both entities committed to maintaining close cooperation to transform national climate priorities into bankable projects.

This collaboration matters as Pakistan seeks to build long-term institutional preparedness and disaster resilience following recent climate-induced disasters. Effectively leveraging international climate funds and private-sector partnerships is vital for sustainable national development.

stories.title: Prime Minister Orders International Testing Labs for Gemstones
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif directed authorities to establish internationally accredited gemstone testing laboratories and provide overseas training for local specialists during a meeting in Islamabad. The initiative aims to modernize Pakistan's gemstone sector, enhance the domestic value chain, and significantly increase export revenues.

During the session, the prime minister instructed that Pakistani master trainers be sent to Sri Lanka and Thailand to master modern processing techniques. Foreign Secretary Asim Iftikhar Ahmad was tasked with ensuring that Pakistani ambassadors in those countries facilitate the training program. The government intends to replace outdated mining practices that currently cause heavy resource wastage.

Official briefings revealed that Pakistan possesses roughly 300 million carats of gemstone reserves across more than 30 varieties, engaging over 9,000 miners and 5,500 businesses. Despite this capacity, the industry struggles with raw stone exports, processing losses exceeding 50 percent, and technical skill shortages. A Rs4.10 billion project is underway to establish facilitation centers in Gilgit-Baltistan, Azad Jammu and Kashmir, and Islamabad.

The reforms also involve executing the National Gemstone Policy 2026-2030, which introduces a national certification system, tax exemptions on imported machinery, and a proposed ban on raw stone exports. Key officials contributing to these policies include Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb, Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik, and special assistants Haroon Akhtar and Lt Gen (retd) Muhammad Zafar Iqbal.

This policy shift is crucial for transforming Pakistan from an exporter of unprocessed stones into a finished-product manufacturer. Retaining a greater share of value locally is expected to boost the country's export economy substantially.

stories.title: FBR Exempts Federal Excise Duty on Industrial Petroleum Inputs
stories.summary:
The Federal Board of Revenue amended the Federal Excise Rules of 2005 via SRO 2286(I)/2026 to exempt specific petroleum products and minerals from the Federal Excise Duty. The exemption applies to petroleum top naphtha, white spirit, and mineral turpentine oil when utilized exclusively as industrial inputs by registered manufacturers according to their allocated quotas.

Previously, the FBR had levied an excise duty of Rs80 per litre on these three products starting July 1, 2026. The newly introduced Chapter IV-A establishes a quota-based framework to ensure these materials are strictly used in manufacturing processes without diversion, detailing strict procedures for quota allocation, consumption monitoring, and duty recovery for non-compliance.

Manufacturers seeking duty-free imports or local supplies must submit applications to their respective Commissioner Inland Revenue. Applicants are required to provide details including Form-L licenses, HS codes, installed production capacities, and historical consumption data. The commissioner will verify these details through sales tax returns and electronic invoices within one month.

Approved quotas will be calculated based on preceding output quantities with an allowance of up to 10 percent for established firms, or up to 50 percent of annual capacity for newer operations. Manufacturers must consume the allocated goods within six months of acquisition or face duty recovery on unconsumed stock.

This regulatory update provides essential relief to industrial manufacturers by streamlining the supply of critical raw inputs. Ensuring predictable and transparent duty exemptions helps protect local industries from excessive cost burdens.

stories.title: Privatization Adviser Details 17 Ongoing Transactions and Projects
stories.summary:
Adviser to the Prime Minister on Privatisation Muhammad Ali announced that the Privatisation Commission is actively managing 17 transactions, which include three major airports, financial institutions like State Life, and nine power distribution companies. Speaking at the CFA Investment Forum in Karachi, he noted that bidding for power entities like FESCO, GEPCO, and IESCO is anticipated in the first quarter of 2027.

The adviser pointed to completed transactions such as PIA and First Women Bank as evidence of successful stakeholder cooperation. Additionally, outsourcing operations for the Islamabad International Airport are targeted for the first quarter of 2027, while due diligence is ongoing for HESCO and SEPCO.

To foster private capital, Ali stressed the necessity of credible feasibility studies and risk allocation, highlighting infrastructure ventures like the M-6 Hyderabad–Sukkur Motorway. This project features two sections with a combined estimated investment of USD 700 million structured under a 25-year concession model. Other developments include Islamabad Technopolis and various properties managed by REDAMCO.

The privatization official emphasized that government involvement in commercial enterprises ties down public resources and exposes taxpayers to unnecessary risks. He stated that investors require predictable regulations, enforceable contracts, and transparent bidding processes to operate with confidence.

This push for privatization and public-private partnerships aims to enhance economic efficiency and reduce financial burdens on the state. Comprehensive reforms in energy and taxation are presented as vital steps to bolster international competitiveness for Pakistani businesses.

stories.title: Rafael Jodar Sends Spain into Davis Cup Semi-Final Against Britain
stories.summary:
Spain advanced to the Davis Cup semi-finals after Rafael Jodar secured a comeback victory against Austria at the Super Tennis Arena in Bologna, Italy, on November 26, 2026. Jodar lost the opening set to Jurij Rodionov before dominating the next two sets, winning 2-6, 6-0, 6-1. The 20-year-old player admitted he struggled to find his rhythm initially but improved his aggressiveness and baseline play to clinch the match. Since teammate Daniel Merida had already defeated Austria's Joel Schwaerzler 6-4, 6-4 in the first singles match, Spain secured an unassailable 2-0 lead, allowing star player Carlos Alcaraz to rest.

Spain captain David Ferrer noted that Alcaraz, who recently won three consecutive individual titles including the ATP Finals, might return for the singles matches against Britain. Spain is pursuing its seventh Davis Cup title and its first since 2019, when Rafael Nadal led the team. The upcoming semi-final opponent, Britain, earned its spot earlier that day by defeating Germany 2-1. British world number one singles player Arthur Fery was defeated by Alexander Zverev, but Cameron Norrie leveled the tie by overcoming Jan-Lennard Struff. In the decisive doubles match, Britain's Henry Patten and Neal Skupski defeated Germany's Kevin Krawietz and Tim Puetz 6-2, 7-6 to send Britain to the semi-finals for the first time in seven years.

Reflecting on the victory, Merida expressed gratitude for securing the opening point for Spain despite not playing at his peak level. Meanwhile, British doubles player Patten praised Skupski's crucial returns on match point. Skupski stated that the team planned to rest, practice briefly, and prepare for their next opponents. In the other half of the tournament, three-time reigning champions Italy were set to face the Czech Republic in the first semi-final on Friday following Italy's victory over South Korea and the Czech team's win against Canada.

stories.title: Bournemouth and AC Milan Secure Remarkable Comeback Wins in Europa League
stories.summary:
Ten-man Bournemouth extended their winning run across all competitions to ten matches with a 2-1 away victory against Celta Vigo in the UEFA Europa League. Playing in Europe for the first time, Marco Rose's side triumphed despite falling behind to a 19th-minute goal by 39-year-old Iago Aspas and losing Bafode Diakite to a red card shortly after. Alvaro Rodriguez equalized early in the second half, and Rayan scored the winner with twelve minutes remaining. The English club currently sits two points clear at the top of the 36-team table.

In another dramatic fixture, AC Milan overcame a two-goal deficit to defeat Olympiakos 4-2 in Greece. Ruben Amorim's squad fell behind following an own goal by Mike Maignan and a strike from Joao Silva. However, Omari Hutchinson sparked a comeback with a solo goal before providing assists for Christian Pulisic and Alphadjo Cisse, with Diego Moreira sealing the victory in stoppage time.

Elsewhere in the tournament, Juventus defeated Omonia 4-1 to claim second place, while Ferencvaros drew goalless with Celje. Crystal Palace secured a 2-1 comeback victory over Real Sociedad thanks to a late winner from Dwight McNeil, whereas Sunderland drew 1-1 with Jagiellonia. Meanwhile, Trabzonspor defeated CSKA Sofia 2-1 with a goal from Mohamed Salah.

The fifth round of matches also faced disruptions due to crowd trouble. A fixture between Besiktas and Hapoel Beer-Sheva in Batumi was temporarily suspended following clashes between Georgian police and Besiktas fans over a pro-Palestinian banner. Additionally, violent incidents between Marseille and Levski Sofia supporters in France resulted in five Bulgarian fans being hospitalized.

stories.title: AJK Government Dismisses Rawalakot Mayor and Cancels Private School Registrations
stories.summary:
The Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK) government dismissed Rawalakot Mayor Abdul Naeem Khan from office and terminated his municipal corporation membership due to alleged involvement in anti-state activities. Operating under Section 23(2) of the Local Government Act, 1990, the Local Government and Rural Development Department issued a formal notification regarding the removal. A separate AJK Home Department notification dated November 15 revealed that Khan's name was included among at least 28 individuals placed on the Fourth Schedule under Section 16 of the AJK Anti-Terrorism Act following a cabinet decision on June 5.

Khan, affiliated with the Jammu Kashmir Peoples Party (JKPP), assumed office as mayor in 2023. Prior to his election, he led a faction of the Rawalakot traders' body where Joint Awami Action Committee (JAAC) leader Umar Nazir Kashmiri served as his deputy. The region experienced significant unrest and violence between June and July, primarily driven by the JAAC's demand to abolish 12 refugee seats in the AJK Legislative Assembly. Following planned strikes in June, the former PPP-led AJK administration proscribed the JAAC under the local ATA, while federal authorities alleged that militant factions backed by Indian funding were orchestrating the unrest.

In a parallel move, the AJK Elementary and Secondary Education Department authorised the cancellation of registrations for 14 private educational institutions across Poonch district, covering Rawalakot, Hajira, Jandali, and Thorar. The chairman of the AJK Private Educational Institutions Regulatory Authority (Peira) approved the directive under Rule 8(3) of the Private Educational Institutions Rules, 2015. Authorities stated the action targeted schools allegedly participating in activities threatening state integrity and solidarity, marking another wave of shutdowns following the prior cancellation of 10 other private schools on similar grounds.

stories.title: وزیر داخلہ محسن نقوی کا فائر بریگیڈ رسپانس ٹائم کا دورہ
stories.summary:
وفاقی وزیر داخلہ محسن نقوی نے اسلام آباد میں کیپیٹل ڈویلپمنٹ اتھارٹی (سی ڈی اے) کے فائر بریگیڈ اسٹیشن کا اچانک دورہ کیا۔ اس دورے کے دوران انہوں نے وہاں موجود فائر فائٹنگ گاڑیوں اور کال سینٹر کا معائنہ کیا اور عملے کی کارکردگی کو سراہتے ہوئے انہیں شاباش دی۔ وزیر داخلہ نے اس بات پر زور دیا کہ فائر فائٹنگ گاڑیاں فوری طور پر روانہ ہونی چاہئیں تاکہ کسی بھی ہنگامی صورتحال میں تاخیر سے بچا جا سکے۔

دورے کے دوران محسن نقوی نے خود ڈرائیور کے ساتھ سکائی لفٹ گاڑی میں بیٹھ کر فائر بریگیڈ اسٹیشن سے ایف 11 تک کے سفر کا جائزہ لیا۔ اس آزمائشی سفر میں سکائی لفٹ گاڑی نے مقررہ فاصلہ تقریباً 12 منٹ میں طے کیا۔ انہوں نے متعلقہ عملے کو ہدایت جاری کی کہ رسپانس ٹائم کو مزید کم کیا جائے تاکہ ہنگامی حالات میں بروقت رسپانس کے ذریعے کسی بڑے جانی و مالی نقصان کو روکا جا سکے اور شہر کے شہریوں کو بہتر ریسکیو سہولیات فراہم کی جا سکیں۔

stories.title: وزیراعلیٰ سندھ مراد علی شاہ کا بلدیاتی قانون میں تبدیلی کا اعلان
stories.summary:
وزیراعلیٰ سندھ مراد علی شاہ نے صوبائی بلدیاتی قانون میں تبدیلی کا اعلان کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ اس مقصد کے لیے دو ارکان پر مشتمل کمیٹی تمام شراکت داروں سے بات چیت کرے گی۔

صحافیوں سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے انہوں نے بتایا کہ یہ کمیٹی تین ماہ کے اندر اپنی سفارشات مرتب کرکے کابینہ کے سامنے پیش کرے گی۔ ان کی یہ کوشش ہوگی کہ آئندہ بلدیاتی انتخابات نئے قانون کے تحت ہی منعقد کیے جائیں۔

مراد علی شاہ نے قانون میں تبدیلی کے حوالے سے کسی بھی قسم کے دباؤ کے تاثر کو یکسر مسترد کر دیا۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ پاکستان پیپلز پارٹی کے 2024 کے منشور میں اس بارے میں پہلے ہی آگاہ کر دیا گیا تھا۔

اس کے علاوہ انہوں نے صوبوں کے معاملے پر ریفرنڈم کو وقت کا زیاں قرار دیا۔ انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ اگر آئینی طریقہ کار اپنانا ہے تو اس کے لیے صوبائی اسمبلی سے رائے لے لی جائے گی۔

stories.title: فرانس کے 2027 کے سوشل سیکیورٹی بجٹ پر اتفاق نہ ہوسکا
stories.summary:
فرانس میں سال 2027 کے سوشل سیکیورٹی بجٹ کے معاملے پر قانون سازوں کے درمیان اتفاق رائے پیدا نہیں ہو سکا، جس کے باعث اس بجٹ بل کو دوبارہ قومی اسمبلی میں غور کے لیے واپس بھیج دیا گیا ہے۔ پارلیمنٹ کے دونوں ایوانوں پر مشتمل 14 رکنی مشترکہ کمیٹی کے درمیان ہونے والے مذاکرات اس معاملے میں کسی بھی قسم کا سمجھوتہ کرانے میں ناکام رہے ہیں۔

فرانسیسی نشریاتی اداروں کے مطابق وزیر اعظم سباسٹین لیکورنو نے اس معاملے پر تمام فریقین کے درمیان اتفاق رائے پیدا کرنے کی کوششیں جاری رکھنے کا باضابطہ اعلان کیا ہے۔ طے پایا ہے کہ اس متنازع بجٹ بل پر قومی اسمبلی میں دوبارہ بحث کا آغاز آئندہ ماہ کی 7 تاریخ سے کیا جائے گا، اور بحث مکمل ہونے کے بعد بل کو سینیٹ میں بھی پیش کیا جائے گا۔

دونوں ایوانوں کے مابین شدید اختلافات کی سب سے بڑی وجہ سال 2023 کی پنشن اصلاحات کو معطل رکھنا ہے۔ جہاں ایک طرف سینیٹ کی یہ خواہش ہے کہ ان اصلاحات کو سال 2027 سے دوبارہ نافذ کیا جائے، وہیں دوسری طرف قومی اسمبلی کے متعدد ارکان اس تجویز کی شدید مخالفت کر رہے ہیں۔

فرانسیسی حکومت کا بنیادی ہدف یہ ہے کہ سوشل سیکیورٹی کے خسارے کو سال 2026 میں متوقع 21.8 ارب یورو سے کم کر کے سال 2027 تک 12.7 ارب یورو کی سطح پر لایا جائے۔ اس مالی ہدف کو حاصل کرنے کے لیے حکومت کی جانب سے صحت کے شعبے کے اخراجات میں کمی اور پنشن کی ادائیگیوں کے نظام میں ضروری تبدیلیاں لانے جیسے کئی اہم اقدامات تجویز کیے گئے ہیں۔

stories.title: Karachi Traffic Disrupted as Protests Cause Severe Road Closures
stories.summary:
Residents of Karachi encountered severe commuting difficulties on Thursday due to multiple road blockages and heavy traffic congestion caused by various protests across the city. The Karachi Traffic Police reported that the Superhighway near Al Asif Square was completely closed for inbound and outbound traffic, forcing authorities to implement alternative routes such as Punjab Adda, Total Pump, and Faria Chowk for travelers coming from Hyderabad. Similar closures were enforced on both sides of Hub River Road, where heavy traffic backed up and light vehicles were diverted through inner areas and the Northern Bypass.

Additional protests and road shutdowns affected other critical locations throughout the metropolitan area. Both roads linking Ghaghar Phatak near Sassi Toll Plaza on the National Highway were shut down, prompting traffic police to redirect light traffic from Thatta toward the FFC Factory Area, Steel Mill, and Steel Mill Chowrangi. Traffic flow was also severely slowed around Abu Al-Hasan Isfahani Road, Madras Chowk, Maskan Chowrangi, and Nipa due to the spillover effects from the Superhighway closures. Furthermore, protests temporarily closed down Sharea Faisal near the Baloch Colony flyover and Lucky Pahari on Hub River Road, though police confirmed that some locations later reopened and officers were deployed to manage the flow.

Karachi Traffic Police personnel maintained a visible presence at these various disruption sites to implement necessary diversions and assist commuters. Authorities advised drivers to utilize designated alternative routes to bypass the affected zones while ongoing measures were taken to restore regular traffic movement. The widespread disruptions highlighted significant logistical challenges for daily commuters navigating the city during the demonstrations.

Imtiaz Ali, a Karachi-based reporter with over 25 years of experience, covers crime, politics, courts, government affairs, and the health sector for Dawn.

stories.title: گورنر راج کے بعد خیبر پختونخوا اسمبلی سیکرٹریٹ کھولنے کا فیصلہ
stories.summary:
صوبے میں نافذ ہونے والے گورنر راج کے نتیجے میں معطل ہونے والے خیبر پختونخوا اسمبلی سیکرٹریٹ کو دوبارہ فعال اور کھولنے کا حتمی فیصلہ کر لیا گیا ہے۔ باخبر ذرائع کے مطابق اس اسمبلی سیکرٹریٹ کو آئندہ ماہ کے دوران دوبارہ کھول دیا جائے گا، تاہم تاحال اسے کھولنے کی کسی خاص اور حتمی تاریخ کا اعلان نہیں کیا گیا ہے۔

خیبر پختونخوا میں گورنر راج کے نفاذ کے بعد سے صوبائی اسمبلی کو معطل کر دیا گیا تھا اور اسی وجہ سے اسمبلی سیکرٹریٹ کے دفاتر بھی بند کر دیے گئے تھے۔ بندش کے اس پورے دوران سیکرٹریٹ کے اندر ماضی میں کی جانے والی مختلف بھرتیوں کا تفصیلی ریکارڈ چیک کیا گیا اور ان کی مکمل چھان بین عمل میں لائی گئی۔

گورنر خیبر پختونخوا نے خود اسمبلی سیکرٹریٹ کو جلد از جلد دوبارہ کھولنے کی باضابطہ تصدیق کی ہے اور متعلقہ حکام کو اسے جلد از جلد فعال بنانے کے فیصلوں سے آگاہ کر دیا ہے۔ سیکرٹریٹ کے کھلنے سے صوبائی سطح پر پارلیمانی امور اور انتظامی کارروائیوں کی بحالی میں مدد ملے گی۔

اس اقدام سے صوبے میں سیاسی اور انتظامی سرگرمیوں کو معمول پر لانے کی جانب ایک اور قدم اٹھایا جا رہا ہے۔ گورنر راج کے خاتمے کے بعد اداروں کی بحالی کا یہ عمل انتہائی اہمیت کا حامل ہے تاکہ قانون سازی اور عوامی امور سے متعلق معاملات کو دوبارہ شروع کیا جا سکے۔

stories.title: AJK Government Removes Rawalakot Mayor Over Anti-State Allegations
stories.summary:
The Azad Jammu and Kashmir government removed Rawalakot Mayor Abdul Naeem Khan from office on Thursday, simultaneously terminating his municipal corporation membership due to his alleged involvement in anti-state activities. According to a notification issued by the Local Government and Rural Development Department, the action was executed under Section 23(2) of the Local Government Act, 1990. A separate notification from the AJK Home Department, dated November 15, revealed that Khan’s name was placed on the Fourth Schedule under Section 16 of the AJK Anti-Terrorism Act, following a cabinet decision to target activists of the proscribed Joint Awami Action Committee.

Khan, an elected mayor since 2023 associated with the Jammu Kashmir Peoples Party, previously headed a faction of the Rawalakot traders’ body. The region has experienced months of tension and violence-marred protests, primarily driven by the JAAC's demand to abolish 12 refugee seats in the AJK Legislative Assembly. These demonstrations led to violent clashes between protesters and law enforcement, particularly in June and July. Consequently, the previous AJK government declared the JAAC a proscribed organization on June 5. While the AJK Legislative Assembly recently offered to resume negotiations with the committee subject to the surrender of armed groups and a commitment to constitutional methods, the government has continued taking strict administrative actions against affiliated entities.

In a related development, the AJK Elementary and Secondary Education Department canceled the registration of 14 private educational institutions across Poonch district, including areas in Rawalakot, Hajira, Jandali, and Thorar. Approved by the chairman of the AJK Private Educational Institutions Regulatory Authority under Rule 8(3) of the Rules of 2015, the decision stemmed from reports that these schools engaged in activities contrary to the integrity and solidarity of the state. This followed the earlier cancellation of registrations for 10 other private schools on similar grounds.

stories.title: کمالیہ میں کار اور ٹریکٹر ٹرالی کے تصادم سے گیارہ افراد جاں بحق
stories.summary:
کمالیہ میں رجانہ روڈ پر ایک کار اور ٹریکٹر ٹرالی کے مابین خطرناک تصادم پیش آیا۔ اس حادثے کے نتیجے میں ایک ہی خاندان سے تعلق رکھنے والے گیارہ افراد موقع پر ہی جاں بحق ہو گئے۔

ریسکیو حکام نے حادثے کی تفصیلات فراہم کرتے ہوئے بتایا کہ جاں بحق ہونے والے بدقسمت افراد میں کل چھ بچے، دو خواتین اور تین مرد شامل ہیں۔ اس دلخراش واقعے نے پورے علاقے میں غم کی لہر دوڑا دی ہے۔

ادھر فیصل آباد روڈ بائی پاس پر ایک اور سڑک حادثہ رونما ہوا۔ یہاں ایک تیز رفتار کار بے قابو ہو کر سڑک کے ڈیوائیڈر سے ٹکرا گئی اور الٹ گئی۔

اس دوسرے حادثے کے نتیجے میں دو نوجوان جان کی بازی ہار گئے جبکہ تین دیگر افراد شدید زخمی ہو گئے۔ زخمیوں کو فوری طور پر طبی امداد کے لیے اسپتال منتقل کر دیا گیا ہے۔

stories.title: کرتارپور میں بابا گرو نانک کے جنم دن کی تقریبات کا آغاز
stories.summary:
کرتارپور میں بابا گرو نانک کے 557 ویں جنم دن کی سالانہ تقریبات کا باقاعدہ آغاز کر دیا گیا ہے۔ اس موقع پر ملک سمیت دنیا بھر سے سکھ یاتریوں کی آمد کا سلسلہ تسلسل کے ساتھ جاری ہے۔

دربار انتظامیہ کی جانب سے دی گئی معلومات کے مطابق، بھارت سے واہگہ کے راستے پاکستان پہنچنے والے تئیس سو یاتری آج حسن ابدال سے کرتارپور پہنچیں گے۔ مہمانوں کے استقبال کے لیے تمام انتظامات کو حتمی شکل دے دی گئی ہے۔

دربار کرتارپور میں آنے والے تمام یاتریوں کے لیے قیام و طعام، لنگر خانے، طبی سہولیات اور فول پروف سیکیورٹی کے تمام انتظامات مکمل کر لیے گئے ہیں۔ انتظامیہ زائرین کو بہترین سہولیات فراہم کرنے کے لیے کوشاں ہے۔

ان تقریبات سے بین المذاہب ہم آہنگی کو فروغ ملتا ہے اور دنیا بھر سے آنے والے یاتری مذہبی رسومات پرامن ماحول میں ادا کرتے ہیں۔ حکومت اور دربار انتظامیہ زائرین کی سہولت کے لیے مسلسل فعال ہیں۔

stories.title: علامہ ناصر عباس کا بانی پی ٹی آئی کے بیانیے پر اہم مؤقف
stories.summary:
سینیٹ میں اپوزیشن لیڈر علامہ راجا ناصر عباس نے جیو نیوز کے پروگرام 'آج شاہ زیب خانزادہ کے ساتھ' میں گفتگو کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ جو بانی پی ٹی آئی خود اپنی پارٹی کے ارکان کو پارلیمانی کمیٹیوں میں شمولیت کی اجازت نہیں دے رہے، وہ نئے صوبوں اور ریفرنڈم پر حکومت کی حمایت کیسے کر سکتے ہیں۔

انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ یہ تمام قیاس آرائیاں بانی پی ٹی آئی کے اپنے اصل سیاسی بیانیے کے سراسر خلاف ہیں۔ علامہ ناصر عباس کا مزید کہنا تھا کہ جب تک وہ خود بانی پی ٹی آئی کا براہ راست پیغام نہیں سن لیتے، وہ کسی کی بھی کہی ہوئی بات پر یقین نہیں کریں گے۔

انہوں نے دوٹوک الفاظ میں اعلان کیا کہ وہ اور محمود خان اچکزئی کسی بھی صورت میں بانی پی ٹی آئی کو مائنس نہیں ہونے دیں گے۔ اس کے علاوہ انہوں نے مولانا فضل الرحمٰن کے خلاف اٹھائے جانے والے حکومتی اقدامات کی سخت مذمت بھی کی۔

گفتگو کے دوران انہوں نے اس امر پر زور دیا کہ موجودہ پیچیدہ سیاسی صورتحال میں مسلم لیگ (ن) کے رہنما نواز شریف کو خود سامنے آکر بات کرنی چاہیے۔ انہوں نے ملک کی مجموعی سیاسی صورتحال پر کھل کر اپنے خیالات کا اظہار کیا۔

stories.title: کراچی: ایڈمن سوسائٹی عمارت حادثے میں جاں بحق افراد کی تعداد 6 ہو گئی
stories.summary:
کراچی کے علاقے ایڈمن سوسائٹی میں چھ منزلہ رہائشی عمارت گرنے کے دلخراش واقعے کے بعد امدادی کارروائیاں تاحال جاری ہیں۔ ریسکیو حکام نے جائے وقوعہ پر ملبے سے مزید دو لاشیں نکال لی ہیں، جس کے بعد اس المناک حادثے میں جان کی بازی ہارنے والے افراد کی مجموعی تعداد چھ تک پہنچ گئی ہے۔

حکام نے بتایا کہ ملبے سے برآمد ہونے والی ایک لاش کی شناخت عابد علی کے طور پر کی گئی ہے جبکہ دوسری لاش کی شناخت علی حسن کے نام سے ہوئی ہے جو کہ ظفر گڑھ کا رہائشی تھا۔ قانونی اور ضابطے کی کارروائیوں کو مکمل کرنے کے لیے دونوں لاشوں کو جناح اسپتال منتقل کر دیا گیا ہے۔

اس سانحے کے بعد تاحال تیرہ افراد لاپتہ بتائے جا رہے ہیں۔ انتظامیہ اور ریسکیو اداروں کی جانب سے ملبے تلے دبے ممکنہ افراد کی تلاش اور انہیں بحفاظت نکالنے کے لیے سرچ اور ریسکیو آپریشن کا سلسلہ مسلسل جاری رکھا گیا ہے۔

واقعے کی اطلاع ملتے ہی متاثرہ خاندانوں اور عزیز و اقارب میں شدید غم و غصہ پایا گیا، جس کے پیش نظر ملبے میں دبے افراد کے لواحقین نے احتجاج کرتے ہوئے شارع فیصل کو بلاک کر دیا تھا۔ حکام صورتحال پر قابو پانے اور ریسکیو آپریشن کو جلد از جلد مکمل کرنے کی کوششوں میں مصروف ہیں۔

stories.title: کراچی میں مائی کلاچی روڈ پر دو ٹریلرز کے تصادم سے ایک شخص زخمی
stories.summary:
کراچی کے علاقے مائی کلاچی روڈ پر امریکی سفارت خانے کے قریب پیش آنے والے ٹریفک حادثے کے نتیجے میں ایک فرد زخمی ہو گیا ہے۔ یہ حادثہ دو ہیوی ٹریلرز کے درمیان ٹکر کے باعث رونما ہوا، جس سے علاقے میں وقتی طور پر ہلچل مچ گئی۔

حادثے کی اطلاع ملنے کے فوری بعد امدادی ادارے حرکت میں آئے۔ چھیپا کے ترجمان کی جانب سے فراہم کردہ معلومات کے مطابق واقعے میں زخمی ہونے والے شخص کی شناخت تیس سالہ مہربان ولد بشیر کے طور پر کی گئی ہے۔

امدادی کارروائیوں کے دوران چھیپا کی ایمبولینس نے موقع پر پہنچ کر زخمی ہونے والے مہربان کو طبی امداد کے لیے فوری طور پر سول اسپتال منتقل کر دیا جہاں اس کا علاج جاری ہے۔

شہر کے اس اہم راستے پر پیش آنے والا یہ حادثہ ہیوی ٹریفک کی نقل و حرکت اور حفاظتی تدابیر کے حوالے سے اہمیت کا حامل ہے، کیونکہ اس قسم کے واقعات سے روزمرہ کی آمدورفت متاثر ہوتی ہے۔

stories.title: Sri Lanka Defeats India by Eight Wickets in Rising Stars Asia Cup
stories.summary:
India was knocked out of the Rising Stars Asia Cup after suffering an eight-wicket defeat against Sri Lanka in the first semi-final match held in Doha. Batting first, India A set a target of 317 runs for the loss of eight wickets, driven by Abhishek Sharma's 78 runs and a half-century from Shahbaz Ahmed. Bowlers Shahbaz Ahmed and Harshit Rana each claimed one wicket for India, but their efforts were insufficient to alter the outcome of the match.

Sri Lanka A successfully chased down the 319-run target in 41.3 overs, losing only two wickets in the process to secure their place in the tournament final. Key batting performances for Sri Lanka included Pavan Rathnayake with 31 runs and Nishan Madushka, who contributed a half-century. Meanwhile, Sanath Jayawardena and Diyan Lasantha delivered outstanding innings, scoring 105 and 116 runs respectively.

With this victory, Sri Lanka A advances to the final match of the tournament. In the championship fixture, they are scheduled to face either Bangladesh A or the Pakistan Shaheens.

stories.title: India Presents Bid to IOC for Hosting the 2036 Olympic Games
stories.summary:
The Indian Olympic Association announced on Thursday that it presented a strong case for hosting the 2036 Olympic Games during a virtual presentation to the International Olympic Committee’s Future Host Commission. IOA chief executive Raghuram Iyer stated that the organisation is highly confident of advancing to the next stage of the bidding process. The proposed bid focuses on the western city of Ahmedabad, which is already set to host the 2030 Commonwealth Games and is bidding for the 2038 Asian Games.

To secure the event, India must compete against Germany, Qatar, Hungary, Turkey, South Africa, and South Korea while proving to the IOC that it can successfully manage an event of Olympic scale and complexity. Iyer noted that the bid receives complete backing from all stakeholders, including the central government, emphasizing that such a massive endeavor requires unified support across city, state, and union levels. Supporting infrastructure and venues being built for the 2030 Commonwealth Games in Ahmedabad are intended to serve the Olympics as well.

Selected candidate cities will advance to a strategic dialogue phase in March 2027, followed by a targeted dialogue stage, with the ultimate 2036 host announcement taking place after the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. Although India previously hosted the 2010 Commonwealth Games in New Delhi—which faced corruption and mismanagement allegations that organizers denied—the nation is actively working to build its hosting credentials. However, challenges persist regarding the country's doping record and its athletes' relatively limited overall Olympic success.

stories.title: شدید دھند کی لپیٹ میں آنے کے باعث موٹروے ایم فور فیصل آباد سے پنڈی بھٹیاں تک بند
stories.summary:
شدید دھند کے باعث ٹریفک کی روانی شدید متاثر ہوئی ہے جس کے پیش نظر موٹروے پولیس نے موٹروے ایم فور کو فیصل آباد سے پنڈی بھٹیاں تک ہر قسم کی آمدورفت کے لیے بند کر دیا ہے۔

تاہم، موٹروے پولیس کے مرکزی ترجمان سید عمران احمد کے مطابق موٹروے ایم فور کے باقی تمام حصے دونوں اطراف سے ٹریفک کے لیے تاحال کھلے ہوئے ہیں اور وہاں صورتحال نارمل ہے۔

ترجمان کا کہنا ہے کہ موٹرویز کو عارضی طور پر بند کرنے کا بنیادی مقصد مسافروں کی قیمتی جانوں اور املاک کو محفوظ بنانا ہے تاکہ کسی بڑے حادثے سے بچا جا سکے۔ شہریوں کو مشورہ دیا گیا ہے کہ وہ دھند کے دوران غیر ضروری سفر سے مکمل گریز کریں۔

مسافروں کے لیے ہدایت کی گئی ہے کہ وہ دن کے وقت سفر کو ترجیح دیں کیونکہ صبح دس بجے سے شام چھ بجے تک کا وقت سفر کے لیے نسبتاً محفوظ قرار دیا گیا ہے۔ سفر کے دوران رفتار کم رکھنے، اگلی گاڑی سے مناسب فاصلہ برقرار رکھنے اور لین کی سختی سے پابندی کرنے کی تاکید کی گئی ہے۔

اس کے علاوہ گاڑیوں کے مالکان کو ہدایت کی گئی ہے کہ وہ سفر پر نکلنے سے پہلے اپنی گاڑیوں کی فوگ لائٹس، ہیڈ لائٹس، بیک لائٹس اور وائپرز کو بہترین حالت میں رکھیں، جبکہ غیر ضروری اوورٹیکنگ اور اچانک بریک لگانے سے بھی گریز کریں۔

stories.title: Hamas Weighs Response Following Israeli Airstrikes That Kill Ten in Gaza
stories.summary:
Hamas chief Khalil Al-Hayya stated on Thursday that the group can no longer withstand ongoing Israeli attacks, following strikes in Gaza that local medics reported killed at least 10 people. Among the fatalities was Khaled Abu Nada, a member of Hamas’s political office and the Hamas-appointed deputy minister of education, who died alongside his wife when an apartment in Deir Al-Balah was struck during the third consecutive night of air raids. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu confirmed the targeted killing, stating that approximately 80 Hamas militants have been eliminated over the past month and asserting that no Hamas leader is immune.

The recent escalation includes three additional airstrikes in Gaza City that killed seven individuals in the Tuffah neighborhood, Beach refugee camp, and Sheikh Radwan, alongside a reported fatal shooting in the Bureij refugee camp. The Israeli military stated that Abu Nada managed Hamas’s economic portfolio, banking networks, and funding for militant operations, arguing his death would diminish the group's financial and military capabilities. Conversely, Hamas condemned the killings of academics and civilian figures as heinous crimes and violations of international law and the Gaza ceasefire agreement.

Hamas placed political and moral responsibility for the ongoing violence on US President Donald Trump’s Board of Peace, accusing it of failing to halt attacks and encouraging further bloodshed. Hayya stated that Hamas would consult with other Palestinian factions to determine a response to daily killings and violations, noting that the group cannot accept the current equation of blockade and violence. According to respective Palestinian and Israeli tallies, at least 1,600 Palestinians and 5 Israeli soldiers have died since the October 2025 ceasefire, while Israel's broader military campaign since 2023 has resulted in over 74,000 Palestinian deaths, widespread hunger, and the displacement of Gaza's entire population.

stories.title: Makkah Pact Nations to Discuss Yemen Conflict in Islamabad
stories.summary:
Officials from the mutual defence agreement known as the Makkah pact are scheduled to gather in Islamabad to address the ongoing conflict between Saudi Arabia and Houthi fighters in Yemen, according to Pakistan's Defence Minister Khawaja Asif. The upcoming meeting will bring together foreign and defence ministers from Saudi Arabia, Turkiye, and Pakistan. These three nations originally signed the pact in August, committing to mutual military assistance if any of them face an attack. Riyadh has continuously encountered attacks from Yemen's Houthis, who target cities, maritime shipping, and oil facilities as the civil war's intensity grew.

Asif emphasized that under the terms of the agreement, any aggression directed at Saudi Arabia is considered an attack on both Pakistan and Turkiye. He commended the way Riyadh has managed the hostilities with the Houthis, who currently control large portions of Yemeni territory, including the capital city of Sanaa. The defence minister noted that the defensive alliance, born out of a broader regional conflict expansion following US-Israeli strikes on Iran in February, remains in a nascent phase and requires frequent discussions to establish a concrete framework over the coming months.

While declining to speculate on how the coalition would respond if Iran launched a direct assault on Saudi Arabia, Asif pointed to Israel as a potential source of regional aggression, highlighting the necessity for neighboring nations to unite. He also mentioned Pakistan's previous diplomatic efforts in brokering a temporary halt in fighting between Washington and Tehran, alongside a roadmap for reopening the Strait of Hormuz and addressing Iran's nuclear program. Although that truce ultimately collapsed, Doha and Islamabad have continued shuttle diplomacy to revive the ceasefire, with Asif describing the ongoing mediation outcomes as fragile and incomplete.

stories.title: بلاول بھٹو نے محسن نقوی کو محنتی وزیر قرار دے دیا
stories.summary:
پاکستان پیپلز پارٹی کے چیئرمین بلاول بھٹو زرداری نے ملتان میں میڈیا سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وفاقی وزیر داخلہ محسن نقوی کو سب سے محنتی وزیر قرار دیا اور کہا کہ وہ ان کے بڑے بھائی کی طرح ہیں جو اہم ذمے داریاں اٹھا رہے ہیں۔ انہوں نے بانی پی ٹی آئی کو ایک سیاسی قیدی قرار دیتے ہوئے کہا کہ پاکستان تحریک انصاف ایک سیاسی حقیقت ہے۔

بلاول بھٹو نے مولانا فضل الرحمان کی نظر بندی کی بھی سخت مذمت کی اور واضح کیا کہ ان کے بیانات کو متنازع بنانے کی کوشش کی جا رہی ہے۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ وہ کسی پر تنقید نہیں کر رہے بلکہ صرف اپنا حق اور مؤقف پیش کر رہے ہیں اور ان کی آواز کو دبایا نہیں جا سکتا۔

دوسری جانب اسلام آباد میں مکہ دفاعی معاہدے کے تحت آج ایک اہم اسٹریٹجک سیاسی و دفاعی کمیٹی کا اجلاس طلب کیا گیا ہے۔ اس اجلاس میں پاکستان، ترکیہ اور سعودی عرب کے وزرائے خارجہ اور دفاع شرکت کریں گے جہاں یمن تنازع اور باہمی امور پر تفصیلی گفتگو کی جائے گی۔

علاوہ ازیں، ملک کے دیگر حصوں میں مختلف قانونی اور انتظامی امور بھی زیر بحث رہے۔ لاہور میں ایک نجی انسداد منشیات اسپتال سے ایک لڑکی کی لاش برآمد ہوئی جبکہ اسلام آباد کی سیشن عدالت میں فاطمہ اصغر قتل کیس کی سماعت ہوئی۔ ایف آئی اے نے کارروائی کرتے ہوئے ایک مشتبہ انسانی اسمگلر کو بھی حراست میں لے لیا۔

stories.title: اسلام آباد میں مکہ دفاعی معاہدے کی اسٹریٹجک کمیٹی کا اجلاس
stories.summary:
اسلام آباد میں آج مکہ دفاعی معاہدے کے تحت اسٹریٹجک سیاسی و دفاعی کمیٹی کا ایک اہم اجلاس منعقد ہو رہا ہے۔ اس اعلیٰ سطح کے اجلاس میں پاکستان، ترکیے اور سعودی عرب کے وزرائے خارجہ اور وزرائے دفاع شرکت کر رہے ہیں، جن کا مقصد خطے کی سلامتی اور یمن تنازع پر تبادلہ خیال کرنا ہے۔

وفاقی وزیر دفاع خواجہ آصف کا اس موقع پر کہنا ہے کہ خطے کو اسرائیلی جارحیت کا شدید خطرہ لاحق ہے، اس لیے تمام ممالک کو اپنی صفیں درست کرنا ہوں گی۔ اجلاس کے انتظامات کے حوالے سے لیفٹیننٹ جنرل (ر) نعمان محمود، جو کہ کمیٹی کے سیکریٹری جنرل ہیں، اہم ادارہ جاتی امور سر انجام دے رہے ہیں۔

اجلاس کے پرامن انعقاد اور سیکیورٹی خدشات کے پیش نظر آج اسلام آباد اور راولپنڈی میں مقامی تعطیل کا اعلان کیا گیا ہے، جس کے تحت تمام اسکول، کالجز اور دفاتر بند رہیں گے، البتہ تعلیمی اداروں کے شیڈول کے مطابق سالانہ اور ضمنی امتحانات اپنے وقت پر منعقد ہوں گے۔

یہ پہلا موقع ہے کہ اس مشترکہ کمیٹی کا اجلاس پاکستان میں منعقد ہو رہا ہے، جبکہ اس سے قبل اس قسم کے اجلاس استنبول اور ریاض میں ہو چکے ہیں۔ سفارتی ذرائع کے مطابق اجلاس سے ایک روز قبل تینوں ممالک کے سینئر حکام نے اسلام آباد میں ایک ابتدائی صلاح مشورتی اجلاس بھی منعقد کیا تھا۔

stories.title: Death Toll Rises to Four After Karachi Building Collapse
stories.summary:
Rescue workers pulled another body from the wreckage of a collapsed six-storey building located in the Admin Society near Baloch Colony in Karachi, raising the overall death toll to four. A spokesperson for the Jinnah Postgraduate Medical Centre confirmed that three deceased individuals and fourteen wounded people were initially brought in following the disaster. Out of those injured, thirteen individuals were discharged after receiving medical treatment, while one person continues to receive care at the medical facility.

Local law enforcement authorities registered a formal case regarding the structural failure, incorporating charges of murder, negligence, and carelessness. Police reported that ten individuals have been officially nominated in connection with the incident, and four suspects have been taken into custody so far. The disaster site in the densely populated eastern sector of the city drew large crowds and numerous rescue personnel, who worked to clear heavy bricks and twisted metal while family members displayed photographs of missing relatives on phones at a nearby information desk.

Building failures occur frequently across Pakistan due to substandard construction materials and lax safety enforcement. In Karachi, a metropolis exceeding twenty million residents, problems such as unauthorized building extensions, weak regulatory oversight, overcrowding, and deteriorating infrastructure remain widespread. Following this latest tragedy, the Sindh government initiated a major administrative reshuffle under Chief Minister Murad Ali Shah, removing Sindh Building Control Authority Director General Waseem Shamshad, suspending multiple local officials including the East Deputy Commissioner and East Senior Superintendent of Police, and ordering formal inquiries into the incident.

stories.title: Karachi Police Issue Traffic Advisory Following Highway Closure Due to Protest
stories.summary:
Traffic movement has been completely halted on both directions of the Main National Highway near the Sassi Toll Plaza heading toward Ghaghar Phatak. The closure was implemented on Thursday by Karachi Traffic Police because of an ongoing demonstration in the area.

To manage the disruption, authorities have set up alternative routes for commuters. Vehicles arriving from Thatta are being redirected away from ICI Chowk. Compact automobiles are instructed to take a left turn toward the FFC factory zone, Steel Mills, and Steel Mills Chowrangi.

Additionally, motorists driving from Steel Mills toward Ghaghar Phatak can utilize a link road situated at the T-junction prior to the Sassi Toll Plaza, which connects back to Thatta via the Super Highway. Law enforcement officers are stationed at the location to oversee and regulate traffic movement.

Officials have urged the public to utilize the suggested detours to prevent travel difficulties. Residents seeking further instructions can reach the traffic police helpline at 1915 or check live updates broadcasted on FM 88.6.

stories.title: Bilawal Rejects Referendum on New Provinces as Highly Controversial
stories.summary:
Pakistan Peoples Party Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari expressed strong opposition to holding a referendum on establishing new administrative provinces, warning it would become the most controversial such vote in national history. Speaking at a press conference in Multan, Bilawal argued that wasting time on a public vote is unnecessary because Parliament possesses the authority to create new provinces directly. He emphasized that utilizing a parliamentary, constitutional, and democratic process is the best way to forge necessary political consensus on the matter.

During his address, the PPP chairman noted that while the Punjab Assembly previously passed a resolution supporting a new province under the PML-N government, the Sindh Assembly has consistently rejected similar proposals to divide Sindh. He clarified that his party maintains a uniform stance across provinces and reiterated his personal opposition to splitting Punjab into four separate regions. Shifting to the broader national context, Bilawal stressed that Pakistan requires a democratic reset to restore public faith in governance and tackle pressing national obstacles effectively.

Bilawal urged political stakeholders to diagnose the underlying causes behind the repeated breakdowns of the 1973 Constitution, praising the 18th Amendment for its unique strength. He also encouraged opposition parties to participate in the parliamentary committee focused on electoral reforms, noting that elections will continuously face allegations of rigging from both ruling and opposition factions unless broad political consensus is achieved. Furthermore, he highlighted the recent passage of the 27th Amendment with a two-thirds majority as a significant legislative milestone achieved through cooperation.

stories.title: SEPCO Announces Scheduled Power Outages Across Multiple Feeders for Maintenance
stories.summary:
The Sukkur Electric Power Company Limited (SEPCO) has scheduled a temporary electricity suspension across 24 feeders in various regions. The shutdown is planned for Friday, November 27, 2026, to facilitate necessary maintenance work on the electrical grid.

According to announcements from SEPCO’s Public Relations Office based in Sukkur, power will be cut off between 9:00 AM and either 2:00 PM or 3:00 PM, relying on the specific location. The affected infrastructure includes lines under the 132 kV Khairpur, Shahdad Kot, Ghotki, Khanpur Mahar, Daharki, Larkana New, Ratodero, Larkana Site, Shikarpur, Thull, Dadu, and Sukkur Site jurisdictions, alongside the 66 kV Nara-I network.

Specific areas facing disruptions include Hospital Road in Khairpur, Industrial zones in Mirpur Mathelo and Ghotki, City-IV in Shahdad Kot and Shikarpur, and Salehpat under Nara-I. Other impacted spots involve New Sarhad City, Khanpur City, Shahi Bazar in Daharki, Nazar, and various industrial and trading facilities.

SEPCO has formally extended an apology to all affected electricity consumers for the temporary inconvenience brought on by these essential grid servicing operations.

stories.title: New Study Reveals Alternative Electrical Signaling Mechanism Between Heart Cells
stories.summary:
Heart muscle cells may transmit electrical impulses through a secondary pathway alongside traditional direct channels, according to new research published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. For over fifty years, scientific consensus centered exclusively on gap junctions, which are microscopic channels allowing direct electrical current flow between adjacent cells.

A research team directed by postdoctoral researcher Xiaobo Wu within Robert Gourdie’s laboratory at the Fralin Biomedical Research Institute at VTC uncovered evidence supporting an alternative mechanism known as ephaptic coupling. This process utilizes voltage fluctuations within the perinexus, a nanoscale gap measuring tens of nanometers across where neighboring cardiac cells interface.

To examine this microscopic handoff, Wu engineered a novel technique termed Single-on-Paired, recording electrical readings from a single mouse heart cell while preserving its natural connection to another. Experiments revealed a distinct electrical signature that vanished when sodium levels dropped and gap junctions were experimentally inhibited, but reappeared upon restoring sodium even while gap junctions remained blocked.

Seth Weinberg, a biomedical engineering professor at The Ohio State University, developed a computer model that successfully mirrored the experimental data, demonstrating how local electrical fields can stimulate adjacent cells. Steven Poelzing noted that understanding these pathways could aid investigations into irregular heart rhythms like atrial fibrillation, which impacts over 10 million American adults.

stories.title: Brazilian Delegation Visits NARC to Explore Pakistan Livestock and Goat Breeds
stories.summary:
A high-ranking delegation from Brazil visited the National Agricultural Research Centre in Islamabad to examine Pakistan's indigenous goat breeds and local livestock research. Headed by Rafael Guimarães Requião, Deputy Secretary for Trade and International Relations, the visitors expressed keen interest in the country's diverse genetic resources for meat production.

Talks centered on prospective partnerships involving livestock breeding, genetic enhancement, and the sharing of goat germplasm. Both parties also investigated avenues for joint scientific studies, technology transfer, and creating commercially viable goat breeds suited for meat production.

Federal Minister for National Food Security and Research Rana Tanveer Hussain has been working to modernize Pakistan's agricultural research framework and elevate the livestock industry.
